intended_object: The forgetful (projection) functor Ell/B → Sch/B from the Katz–Mazur category of elliptic curves over B-schemes. It sends (S, E) to the B-scheme S and an arrow to its morphism of bases. This comes from the docstring and the module documentation, which use it to make Ell/B a category fibred in groupoids over Sch/B.
explanation:
In the library, an object of Ell/B is a scheme S with a structure map S → B and an elliptic curve E over S. An arrow is made of a morphism of B-schemes `base`, which comes with the compatibility proof `base_structureMap`, and a cartesian morphism of total spaces that preserves the zero section.

The functor sends an object X to `Over.mk X.structureMap`, which is S viewed as a B-scheme. It sends an arrow f to `Over.homMk f.base f.base_structureMap`, its morphism of bases. This is exactly the projection functor (S, E) ↦ S of Katz–Mazur's Ell/B. Composition and identities are preserved by definition, since `comp_base` and `id_base` hold by `rfl`.

Mathlib's slice category `Over B` is the standard model of Sch/B, so the target category is the right one. The construction has no unnecessary specialisation: it is defined for an arbitrary base scheme B. Mathlib has no separate counterpart, since the category Ell/B is specific to this library.
